calibration.per_outlet_order:
outlet_node ascending; signals.

.p_outlet_mean_mmHg follows the same order
calibration.p_outlet_definition: mean pressure at the distal end of the terminal edge (vessel tip, upstream of Windkessel Rp), over the full profile window
notes: Rp = 0.10*R_total, Rd = 0.90*R_total, C = tau/Rd with tau = 1.75 s (mid of the C2 1.5-2.0 s runoff band).

R_total gives a 90 -> 5 mmHg drop across each Windkessel at its r^3 terminal share of Q_b; the solved operating point is recorded per branch in signals.

.branches [q_mean_mLs], per outlet in p_outlet_mean_mmHg and at the inlets in signals.

.p_in_mean_mmHg.
SI solver values: Rp/Rd [Pa s/m^3] = [mmHg s/mL] * 133.322368*1e6, C [m^3/Pa] = [mL/mmHg] / (133.322368*1e6), Pd = 5 mmHg in Pa.
0D sub-segments are ~10 mm BloodVessel R/L/C elements (R = 8*mu*L/(pi*r^4), L = rho*L/(pi*r^2), C = 2*pi*r^2*L/K_wall, K_wall = 2e5 Pa) exactly as phase2/rom/run_zerod.py.

velocity_calibration.method: rest-state edge velocities u_raw = Q/A_mean (A_mean = (1/L)*integral(pi r^2 ds) over the edge arc); kappa = median over trunks of (0.22 m/s / u_raw) [edges with r_in_mm >= 0.75 mm]; u_cal = kappa*u_raw; per-edge convective transit t = L/u raw and L/(kappa*u) calibrated

solver.backend: steady pressure-driven 0D network solve (reference nodal solver, Picard iteration on Q coupling each lesion's Young-Tsai dP = a*Q + b*Q^2 series loss to residual < 1e-09 mL/s); terminals = 3-element Windkessels in DC (Rp + rd_scale*Rd, C open), roots at Pa. pysvzerod has no native Kv/Kt stenosis/valve element (no pysvzerod.solver module; BloodVessel.stenosis_coefficient is a pure quadratic Ks*Q^2 verified numerically and ValveTanh/PiecewiseValve are closed-loop heart blocks): the closest native element mapping (stenosis_coefficient = Kt quadratic term, R_poiseuille += Kv viscous term) is run through pysvzerod as a cross-check (see solver.pysvzerod.cross_check)

picard.scheme: dP = a*Q + b*|Q_k|*Q Picard on Q, damping 0.5 on stall, residual = max |dQ| between iterates

solver.lesion_placement: each lesion's Young-Tsai loss is a series dP = a*Q + b*Q^2 between the proximal/distal nodes of the 0D sub-segment containing the lesion centroid s_mm (recorded per lesion in solver-independent units via kv/kt/u_throat_m_s)
solver.pd_sampling: per-lesion Pd sampled at the first sub-segment node >= 20 mm distal of the lesion distal end (s_mm + length_mm/2), continuing along the dominant-hyperemia-flow child path past a branch end; pd_location_mm is that sample's position in mm along the path measured from the lesion edge's proximal end (s_mm convention)

pysvzerod.element_mapping: BloodVessel.stenosis_coefficient = Kt*rho/2*(A0/As-1)^2/As^2 (dP = Ks*Q^2, verified numerically), R_poiseuille += Kv*mu*L/(r0^2*As) (Young-Tsai viscous term)

rest.method: pysvzerod steady window (constant PRESSURE roots / RESISTANCE = Windkessel DC terminals), settled means over the second half of the window vs the Picard solution

hyper.method: pysvzerod steady window (constant PRESSURE roots / RESISTANCE = Windkessel DC terminals), settled means over the second half of the window vs the Picard solution

A.method: 1D finite-volume MUSCL-TVD (Superbee limiter) explicit advection + central diffusion (D=1e-3 mm^2/s), adaptive CFL<=0.5 sub-cycling, flow-weighted junction mixing, discrete face-flux mass budget

B.method: 1D finite-volume MUSCL-TVD (Superbee limiter) explicit advection + central diffusion (D=1e-3 mm^2/s), adaptive CFL<=0.5 sub-cycling, flow-weighted junction mixing, discrete face-flux mass budget

C.method: 1D finite-volume MUSCL-TVD (Superbee limiter) explicit advection + central diffusion (D=1e-3 mm^2/s), adaptive CFL<=0.5 sub-cycling, flow-weighted junction mixing, discrete face-flux mass budget

inflow.c_in_definition: flow-weighted mean contrast fraction of the total root inflow (= 1 during a contrast segment and 0 during saline/washout in `replace` mode; diluted by the baseline in `additive` mode)
inflow.initial_condition: steady baseline perfusion (washout split Q_b ~ root_radius^3) at t=0; the protocol's first segment starts at t=0

svzero_config.note: exact pysvzerod model JSON used for the profile-A solve; profiles B/C reuse the identical model with their own FLOW waveforms (per-root piecewise-constant inflow protocol)
